The figure is interactive. You can:

-   Hover over points to inspect values.
-   Zoom and pan.
-   Hide or show species using the legend.
-   Reset the view using the plot controls.



```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(plotly)
library(coda)

data_file <- "data_JAGS_2026_v1.rds"               # same data file as the model
fit_file  <- "output/H1_noTS_fitto2025_fc2026.RData"    # output of H1_noTS_forecast_2026.R

first_year <- 2000
T_fit      <- 26                      # 2025 = year 26
fc_year    <- first_year + T_fit      # 2026
```

```{r observed}
load(data_file)                       # input.data
y    <- input.data$y[,    1:T_fit]
area <- input.data$area[, 1:T_fit]

obs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:T_fit, function(t) {
  ok <- !is.na(y[, t]) & !is.na(area[, t]) & area[, t] > 0
  data.frame(
    year     = first_year + t - 1,
    obs_dens = sum(y[ok, t]) / sum(area[ok, t]),
    obs_se   = sd(y[ok, t]) / sqrt(sum(ok)),
    n_sites  = sum(ok)
  )
}))
obs$lower_ci <- obs$obs_dens - obs$obs_se
obs$upper_ci <- obs$obs_dens + obs$obs_se
```


```{r forecast}
e <- new.env()
load(fit_file, envir = e)
S <- as.matrix(get(ls(e)[1], envir = e))          # draws x parameters (all chains)

P_pred <- S[, grep("^P_pred\\[", colnames(S)), drop = FALSE]
P_pred <- P_pred[, order(as.integer(gsub("\\D", "", colnames(P_pred)))), drop = FALSE]

ok <- !is.na(y[, T_fit]) & !is.na(area[, T_fit]) & area[, T_fit] > 0 &
      colSums(is.na(P_pred)) == 0
pred_dens <- rowSums(P_pred[, ok, drop = FALSE]) / sum(area[ok, T_fit])

fc <- data.frame(
  year      = fc_year,
  pred_mean = mean(pred_dens),
  pred_lo   = unname(quantile(pred_dens, 0.025)),
  pred_hi   = unname(quantile(pred_dens, 0.975)),
  n_sites   = sum(ok)
)

# Hover text
obs$hover_text <- sprintf(
  "<b>Observed %d</b><br>Density: %.2f birds/km<sup>2</sup><br>+/- 1 SE: %.2f to %.2f<br>Sites: %d",
  obs$year, obs$obs_dens, obs$lower_ci, obs$upper_ci, obs$n_sites)
fc$hover_text <- sprintf(
  "<b>Forecast %d (H1_noTS)</b><br>Density: %.2f birds/km<sup>2</sup><br>95%% CrI: %.2f to %.2f<br>Sites: %d",
  fc$year, fc$pred_mean, fc$pred_lo, fc$pred_hi, fc$n_sites)
```

## Interactive figure

```{r interactive-figure}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
obs_colour <- "#333333"
fc_colour  <- "#D55E00"

# Dynamic y-axis limit with 10% headroom
y_max <- max(c(obs$upper_ci, fc$pred_hi), na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(y_max) || y_max <= 0) y_max <- 1
y_axis_max <- y_max * 1.10

p <- plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_ribbons(
    data = obs,
    x = ~year,
    ymin = ~lower_ci,
    ymax = ~upper_ci,
    name = "Observed +/- 1 SE",
    legendgroup = "observed",
    fillcolor = obs_colour,
    line = list(color = "transparent"),
    opacity = 0.20,
    hoverinfo = "none",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = obs,
    x = ~year,
    y = ~obs_dens,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    name = "Observed (+/- 1 SE)",
    legendgroup = "observed",
    line = list(color = obs_colour, width = 3),
    marker = list(color = obs_colour, size = 7),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = fc,
    x = ~year,
    y = ~pred_mean,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    name = "Forecast 2026 (95% CrI)",
    legendgroup = "forecast",
    marker = list(color = fc_colour, size = 12, symbol = "diamond"),
    error_y = list(
      type = "data",
      symmetric = FALSE,
      array = ~pred_hi - pred_mean,
      arrayminus = ~pred_mean - pred_lo,
      color = fc_colour,
      thickness = 2,
      width = 8
    ),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  )

p |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = list(text = ""),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      tickmode = "linear",
      dtick = 1,
      tickangle = -45,
      range = c(first_year - 0.8, fc_year + 0.8),
      tickfont = list(size = 12),
      automargin = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Density (birds/km<sup>2</sup>)",
      range = c(0, y_axis_max),
      tickformat = ".1f",
      automargin = TRUE
    ),
    margin = list(b = 110, l = 100, r = 40, t = 80),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend = list(title = list(text = ""))
  ) |>
  plotly::config(
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d")
  )
```

::: figure-caption
**Ptarmigan forecast 2026**
:::

## Observed density 2000–2025

Per year, over the sites surveyed that year: observed density = sum of counts / sum of surveyed area (birds/km²); SE = sd(counts) / √(number of sites); band = density ± 1 SE.
## Forecast density 2026 from P_pred

Per posterior draw: sum of `P_pred` over the sites surveyed in 2025 / their summed area (= `area_pred` in the model). Point = posterior mean, bars = 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles.
## Data and provenance

-   Number of line transects included: `180`
-   Years included: `2000` to `2025`

The figure is generated from an existing published state variable on the COAT Data Portal. This document does not calculate a new state-variable version, upload files, or modify metadata on the COAT data portal.
